Detailed Description

A UGen which allows repatching.

This allows its source UGen to be changed after construction optionally with a crossfade.

See also:
UGen::setSource(), UGen::fadeSource()

Plug::Plug ( UGen const &  source,
bool  shouldAllowAutoDelete = true 
) throw ()

Base Plug Constuctor, use the AR() and KR() versions in user code.

Generic UGen argument documentation: Arguments which are UGen type can be continuously controlled and these may generally be multichannel (although there are some exceptions). Arguments which are constant/literal values (e.g., float or int) are clearly not continuously controllable and not multichannel (therefore will generallly be applied identically to each channel should the UGen being created is made multichannel via other arguments. Arguments which are Buffer type may require a Buffer for some specific purpose (e.g, TableOsc uses a buffer for its wavetable) but single channel Buffer objects are also used to specify an array of literal values (e.g., LLine)

Parameters:
source The initial source of the Plug. The number of channels this Plug can support is governed by the number of channels in this original source UGen. You could use UGen::emptyChannels() to initialise a Plug with a specific number of channels. The source may be changed later using UGen::setSource(), UGen::fadeSource()
shouldAllowAutoDelete If true this behaves like most other UGen classes i.e., it may be deleted by a DoneAction (e.g., an envelope ending). If false this protects UGen instances further up the chain (and itself) from being deleted by DoneActions.
